from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util
import re

path = Path('/work/textmask.py')
new_code = '''import re


def name_tokens(name: str) -> list[str]:
    return sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True)


def masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    """The text with the skill's own name and its parts replaced, lower-cased."""
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in name_tokens(name):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\\b", "x", t)
    return t
'''
path.write_text(new_code)

# behavior checks against pre-refactor logic

def old_masked(text: str, name: str) -> str:
    t = text.lower()
    for tok in sorted({name} | set(name.split("-")), key=len, reverse=True):
        if len(tok) >= 3:
            t = re.sub(r"\b" + re.escape(tok) + r"\b", "x", t)
    return t

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('textmask', str(path))
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

# deterministic cases
cases = [
    ("Foo bar baz", "foo"),
    ("alpha-beta alpha beta alphabet", "alpha-beta"),
    ("A B C abc abcd", "A-bc"),
    ("name with dots a.b and hyphen", "a.b-c"),
    ("repeat repeat-repeat REPEAT", "repeat-repeat"),
    ("short an on of words", "an-on-of"),
    ("MixedCase Token", "MixedCase-Token"),
]
for text, name in cases:
    n = mod.masked(text, name)
    o = old_masked(text, name)
    assert n == o, (text, name, n, o)

# basic randomized coverage
import random, string
random.seed(0)
chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + '-_. '
for _ in range(200):
    text = ''.join(random.choice(chars) for _ in range(random.randint(0, 80)))
    name = ''.join(random.choice(chars.replace(' ', '')) for _ in range(random.randint(1, 20)))
    assert mod.masked(text, name) == old_masked(text, name)

# structure checks
src = path.read_text()
assert src.count('def ') == 2
assert 'import re' in src
